deployments_detail.use: Internal generative-AI adoption for employees: internally developed generative-AI applications plus Microsoft 365 Copilot for document preparation and knowledge sharing across JPX staff under the Medium-Term Management Plan 2027. [Microsoft 365 Copilot]
deployments_detail.value: ~12 working hours saved per employee per month (internal survey)

deployments_detail.use: Survey of TCFD/climate disclosure using generative AI: JPX used generative AI to automatically determine whether climate-related information was disclosed in Annual Securities Reports across surveyed listed companies. [none]
"J-LENS" AI disclosure-information natural-language search service (β Dec 2025); generative AI for internal ops
JPxData Portal: uses generative AI to analyze disclosure documents and earnings reports and auto-assign keyword/business tags so users can search listed companies by product or service names. [none]

J-LENS: AI-powered natural-language search service over TDnet disclosure documents and securities reports for ~4,000 TSE-listed companies (from 3 years to 2 days before query), aimed at improving investor access to filings. [none]
deployments_detail.value: ~150,000 disclosure documents filed per year; ~4,000 companies covered

deployments_detail.use: J-LAKE data platform: JPXI's cloud data platform centrally managing market and alternative data, combining AI, machine learning and generative AI to power disclosure-material search and investment-opportunity discovery, built with AWS. [AWS]
TDnet renewal disclosure-preparation support: planned generative-AI feature to assist listed companies throughout the process of preparing corporate disclosure materials. [none]

JPX Market Explorer / StockWise: multilingual generative-AI service giving retail and overseas investors company overviews, stock screening, and fundamental ratings for TSE-listed companies, built on Bridgewise's generative AI. [Bridgewise (generative AI), AWS Bedrock]
deployments_detail.value: 3,600+ TSE stocks covered; 12 languages; 2x site traffic post-launch

deployments_detail.use: AI-based market surveillance: JPX-Regulation and Tokyo Stock Exchange deploy NEC 'Advanced Analytics - RAPID machine learning' and Hitachi AI Technology/H to score and detect potential unfair trading, letting the AI learn on its own rather than relying on preset patterns so surveillance staff can focus on detailed investigations. [NEC (RAPID machine learning), Hitachi (Hitachi AI Technology/H)]

Generative AI for CCP risk management: Japan Securities Clearing Corporation (JSCC) proof-of-concept, with NRI, using generative AI to create hypothetical market-data scenarios for risk management / stress testing (JPX Working Paper Vol.48). [Nomura Research Institute (NRI)]
AI for listing examination and compliance analysis: JPX applies AI to analyze fraud risks in listing applications and support regulatory compliance reviews under its AI-utilization program. [none]
